Highlights: Starting town. Professor Oak's Lab, player house, rival house.
Early wild Pokemon and ledges. Short path to Viridian.
Poke Mart (Oak's Parcel), Trainer School, Pokemon Center. Gym (Giovanni, Earth Badge) opens after you have 7 badges.
Rival battles. West of Viridian toward the Pokemon League.
Badge-check gates; you need all 8 badges to pass.
Final dungeon before the Pokemon League. Moltres is found here in FireRed/LeafGreen.
Pokemon League: Elite Four (Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance) then the Champion (your rival).

Connects to: Viridian City; Viridian Forest; Diglett's Cave
Highlights: Cut tree and a gatehouse. Diglett's Cave entrance on this side.
Tunnel between Route 2 and Route 11. Diglett and Dugtrio.
Bug-type trainers and Pokemon. Pikachu can appear (FireRed/LeafGreen).
Leads to Pewter City.
Gym (Brock, Boulder Badge). Museum of Science.
Trainers and ledges on the way to Mt. Moon.
Fossils (Helix / Dome), Moon Stones, Clefairy, Zubat.
Leads out of Mt. Moon to Cerulean.

Connects to: Route 4; Route 5; Route 9; Route 24; Cerulean Cave
Highlights: Gym (Misty, Cascade Badge). Bike Shop. Starting point for Nugget Bridge.
Nugget Bridge: a chain of trainers with a Nugget as the reward.
Leads to Bill's cottage.
Meet Bill; reward is the S.S. Ticket.
Endgame cave with the strongest wild Pokemon, including Mewtwo. Needs Surf.

Connects to: Cerulean City; Saffron City; Underground Path
Highlights: Pokemon Day Care is on this route.
Underground passages that link the north/south and east/west routes.
Gym (Sabrina, Marsh Badge). Silph Co. headquarters (Team Rocket takeover). Fighting Dojo.
Short route south to Vermilion.
Gym (Lt. Surge, Thunder Badge). S.S. Anne dock (HM Cut). Pokemon Fan Club.
Gatehouse where Oak's aide rewards Pokedex progress (Itemfinder).
Short link between Saffron and Celadon.
Gym (Erika, Rainbow Badge). Game Corner, Department Store, Celadon Mansion.
Team Rocket base under the Game Corner. Silph Scope is found here.
Link between Saffron and Lavender (Underground Path entrance).
Cut tree. Leads east to Rock Tunnel.

Connects to: Route 9; Rock Tunnel; Lavender Town; Power Plant
Highlights: Rock Tunnel entrance in the north; Power Plant reached across water.
Dark cave; Flash makes it much easier.
Abandoned power plant. Zapdos is found here.
Pokemon Tower (ghost-type area), Mr. Fuji's house, Name Rater.
A sleeping Snorlax blocks the path until you have the Poke Flute. Fishing Guru gives the Super Rod.
Coastal route heading west toward Fuchsia.
Continues west.
Gatehouse where Oak's aide rewards more Pokedex progress (Exp. Share).
Another sleeping Snorlax blocks the way; house with HM Fly nearby.
Cycling Road: Bicycle required, fast downhill route with many trainers.
Southern end of Cycling Road.
Gym (Koga, Soul Badge). Safari Zone, Warden's house.
Catch rare Pokemon with Safari Balls. Hidden items include HM Surf and HM Strength.
Surf south; many swimmer trainers.
Surf west; leads past the Seafoam Islands.
Icy cave. Articuno is found here.
Gym (Blaine, Volcano Badge; needs the Secret Key). Pokemon Lab (fossil revival).
Burned-down mansion. The Secret Key for the Cinnabar Gym is found here.
Surf north to close the loop back to Pallet Town.
